note: Permafrost Execution (final, 19 frames, the first five of the 14-frame version lasting twice as long): frames 1-11 settle and focus at home (hands crossed on her chest, eyes closed; the frost gathers), 12 the dash (half way: x 0.5, a small arc), 13 the arrival (x 1 = 0.8 character widths in front of the target), 14 the SLASH (the hit), 15-17 the finishing pose (the X freezes), 18 the retreat (x 0.5), 19 home in the idle stance. x is a share of the way to the strike point, y an arc in character widths. 12 fps makes it 1.58 s.
